title: Contractors

help.title: About Contractors
help.overview: A Contractor is a company or professional you attach to buildings and, optionally, to unit costs. This directory is contractors, architects, engineers, and similar parties — not a user account and not a building.

sections.title: What a contractor holds
items: Optional email, phone, description, website, and logo.
Optional addresses (street, postal code, city, and country are required on each address; state is optional; map coordinates are required when you add an address).
Party type: contractor, architect, engineer, quantity surveyor (QS), project manager (PM), surveyor, or other.
Trades (short free text), insurance expiry date, performance score from 0 to 100.

sections.title: On this page
items: Create a contractor — name and VAT are required.
Search and filter the list; open a row to edit identity, addresses, and scores.
Delete is a soft delete and can be restored. Deleting unlinks this contractor from buildings that listed it. Those buildings are not deleted.

sections.title: How it behaves
items: Creating a contractor does not assign it anywhere. You pick it later on a building (optional contractors list) or on a unit cost.
Several contractors can sit on one building. One contractor can sit on many buildings.
Unit costs can point at one contractor as the vendor for that purchase. That link is optional.

sections.title: Typical next step
items: Create the firms and professionals you work with.
On each building, attach the relevant contractors.
When booking unit costs, pick the contractor if you want the invoice tied to this directory.
